# JustWatch

> JustWatch is a comprehensive streaming guide that helps users discover where to watch movies and TV shows across multiple platforms.

JustWatch provides a centralized platform for browsing streaming catalogs, comparing availability across providers like Netflix, Disney+, HBO Max, and Amazon Prime Video, and discovering new content. The site includes regional guides, sports streaming information, and curated entertainment lists to help users find exactly what they want to watch and where to watch it.

## Key Topics

- streaming guide
- movies and TV shows

## Core Streaming Guides

- [JustWatch - The Streaming Guide](https://www.justwatch.com): JustWatch homepage - central streaming guide for movies & TV shows
- [JustWatch US - The Streaming Guide for Movies and TV Shows](https://www.justwatch.com/us): US regional streaming guide for discovering movies and TV shows
- [JustWatch - New and recently added movies and TV shows](https://www.justwatch.com/us/new): Browse newly released and recently added content across streaming services

- [HBO Max - full list of movies and TV shows online](https://www.justwatch.com/us/provider/hbo-max): HBO Max complete catalog with premium content directory
- [Amazon Prime Video - full list of movies and TV shows online](https://www.justwatch.com/us/provider/amazon-prime-video): Complete Amazon Prime Video catalog with content discovery
- [Apple TV - full list of movies and TV shows online](https://www.justwatch.com/us/provider/apple-tv-plus): Apple TV+ complete catalog browsing and discovery
- [Hulu - full list of movies and TV shows online](https://www.justwatch.com/us/provider/hulu): Hulu streaming catalog directory and content discovery
